//==
// Shears space: translates each point by Rate * t, where t is signed distance
// from Origin along Axis. Rate of zero is the identity.
type Shear3D
    implements IValue, IDeformation3D
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    Rate: Vector3D;
}
